text:
maria-cs: Heads-up — prepping QBR for Nimbus (renewal 2026-05-10). Token burn spiked over the last 7 days, want a focused run-through: spend forecast, enablement status, and short-term mitigation options. Can we triage now? cc @daniel-am @olivia-fin :eyes: 

daniel-am: On it. Quick top-line: current M/M tokens ~ 3.2B, projected spend w/ recent trend ~= $123k/mo vs their commit of $80k/mo. I'll pull model/route breakdown and send a CSV.

olivia-fin: Finance flagged this as a high variance. Please include expected delta vs commit and any one-time causes. We need decision on alert thresholds (auto-top-up vs escalation).

kevin-se: Onboarding note — only 2 of 5 product teams have switched to batch+cache patterns. Most traffic is short-lived single-request calls which blows up per-token cost. Recommend: enable batching, reduce system prompt length, and add KV prefix cache for session flows. I can draft a 1-page runbook.

maria-cs: Action list (48h): DAN = spend by model + by endpoint; KEVIN = enablement checklist + runbook for batching + a short demo gif; OLIVIA = define financial thresholds & recommend top-up vs amendment; JEN = capture product feedback and any quality regressions they reported. I'll coordinate the Nimbus sync invite.

jen-support: Adding notes from last enablement call — customer reports frequent long outputs from their 'analysis' route which they then re-request with different params. That doubles tokens. I asked them to try `max_tokens: 512` + `stop` anchors but haven't seen confirmation. I can reach out and capture exact examples.

deploy-bot: billing-anomaly: account=nimbus delta=+52% baseline_window=7d alert_id=ANOM-20260318-7 

daniel-am: Sample breakdown I pulled: model-ox-large = 60% tokens, embeddings = 10%, system prompts = 15%, misc retries = 15%. Quick mitigations: (1) trim system prompts and store instructions in customer-side state; (2) enable prefix KV cache; (3) enforce batching on high-cardinality routes. For QBR propose a 3-step plan: short-term cap+alerts, mid-term enablement/config changes, long-term commit adjustment.

maria-cs: Good. I'll schedule a 30-min triage with Nimbus CSM + AM + Finance TOMORROW 10:00am PT. Draft agenda: numbers + root causes, mitigations + owners, commercial options.

olivia-fin: If they prefer a commit top-up, finance can propose a 6-month stepped commitment: $95k/mo with overage protection in month 1–2. Need legal to draft amendment.

kevin-se: I'll have the 1-pager + a 45s demo clip for enabling batching in the SDK ready EOD tomorrow. Also will include a snippet to reduce system prompt size. Example snippet: ```js
// enable batching example
client.batchRequests([req1, req2])
```

maria-cs: Perfect. I'll capture owners in the calendar invite and update the QBR prep doc (internal link) with these action items. Thanks team :muscle:

jen-support: I'll follow up with Nimbus to get concrete example payloads they used (should help reduce false positives and identify where retries happened).

maria-cs: Closing: record of decisions + next steps in the prep doc; we will reconvene after the 30-min sync and update renewal risk flag if they don't accept mitigations.
